t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice was to see which Gomes relate to the colour of basket in the forest, there are only two colours of basket. For a while one basket should give better rewards but this changes at some point whereby it is suggested to find the gnome that gives the other colour of basket to continue to get the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: There are different coloured gnomes that correspond to either a red or yellow basket.After a few turns you will get used to which gnomes relate to each basket.It seemed to me that for a time one basket gives more mushrooms for a time. After a while this seems to swap to the other basket.When one basket was giving low results I switched to the other coloured one.
